title: Content
description: News, articles, public projects and case studies for the website, in both languages.
readOnly: You can view this entry but not edit it. Ask an administrator for the content editor role.

descriptions.articles: Longer insight pieces with a reading time.
descriptions.public_projects: Showcase entries for the website portfolio. Separate from internal projects.
descriptions.case_studies: Challenge, solution, implementation and measured outcomes.
descriptions.authors: People credited on news and articles.
descriptions.categories: Grouping per content type. Slugs appear in public URLs.
descriptions.tags: Free form keywords shared by news and articles.

list.emptyDescription: Create the first entry, or widen the filters.

form.newHint: New entries start as drafts. Publishing is a separate step on the entry page.
form.title: Title
form.slugHint: Part of the public URL. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; follows the English title until you edit it.
form.author: Author
form.scheduledForHint: Amman time. The entry goes live automatically at this moment.
form.coverHint: Shown on listings and social previews. Use a wide image, ideally 1600 by 900 pixels.
form.seoHint: Optional overrides for the page title and description. Leave empty to reuse the title and excerpt.
form.languageStatusHint: Controls which language versions the website links to.
form.clientDisplayNameHint: As it should appear publicly. Leave empty for a confidential client.
form.servicesHint: Comma separated list, for example: Penetration testing, Cloud hardening.
form.internalProjectHint: Editor only. Links this public entry to an internal project for your own reference. Never shown on the website.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Measurable results shown as a row of figures on the case study page.
impact.verifiedHint: Only tick verified when the figure was confirmed with the client. Unverified figures are shown with a note.

images.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or SVG, up to 10 MB. The image is stored when you upload it and linked when you save.

workflow.publishNeedsPermission: Publishing and scheduling need the content.publish permission.
workflow.deleteDescription: This removes the entry permanently. Archive it instead if it may be needed again.
workflow.scheduleDescription: The entry is published automatically at the chosen time (Amman).

authors.emptyDescription: Add the people who will be credited on news and articles.
authors.deleteDescription: Entries by this author keep their content but lose the byline.

form.name: Name
form.title: Title or role
form.employeeHint: Optional. Links the byline to an employee profile.

categories.deleteDescription: Entries in it keep their content and become uncategorised.

tags.deleteDescription: It is removed from every entry that uses it.
